name.quote: Growth | Pass in 1 day ... Select | Pass in 3 days ... Lightning | Instant
name.note: first-listed 50K evaluation plan; selection under the spec rule is the lead's

billing.quote: All plans are one-time purchases with no recurring billing.

activation_fee.quote: There are no activation fees for any current Tradeify account type.

max_loss_type.value: EOD trailing (updates at end of day, enforced intraday on net liquidation; no lock in evaluation)
max_loss_type.quote: The GROWTH™ evaluation uses an End of Day Trailing Max Drawdown, which is based on the account balance at the end of the trading day.

daily_loss_limit.quote: If you hit it, trading stops for the day but your account is not failed.

consistency_eval.quote: A: No. GROWTH™ evaluation does NOT have a consistency requirement.

min_days.quote: Minimum Trading Days | 1 day (can pass immediately)

time_limit.quote: There is no deadline to hit the profit target

flat_by.quote: Close all positions by 4:45 PM Eastern Time (Monday-Friday)

monthly_eval_cap.quote: it does not count toward the 15-evaluation monthly limit

type.value: simulated (Sim Funded); may be moved to Live after any payout
type.quote: Tradeify reserves the right to move you to a Live Funded Account at any time after a successful payout.

start_balance.quote: Your funded account starts at your base account size ($50K, $100K, or $150K) regardless of your evaluation ending balance.

max_loss.value: EOD trailing 2,000; locks at floor 50,100 when EOD balance >= 52,100 or at first payout request
max_loss.quote: A 50K Growth account with $2,000 drawdown locks when EOD balance reaches $52,100. The drawdown floor becomes $50,100 and never moves up again.

daily_loss_limit.quote: Growth Accounts: Daily loss limit varies by account size ($1,250 for $50k, $2,500 for $100k, $3,750 for $150k)

split.quote: Traders receive 90% of the payout amount requested.

payout_caps.quote: These are hard caps — even if your account balance is higher, you can only withdraw up to the amount shown for that payout number

winning_days.unit: days with profit > 150 USD per payout cycle
winning_days.quote: Minimum Trading Days: 5 or more of the Trading Days must show a profit greater than: ... $150 in profit for 50k accounts

consistency.unit: max share of one day in total profit
consistency.quote: Consistency Rule: Abide by the 35% Consistency Rule
consistency.note: exact formula in Consistency Rule article, not fetched

microscalping.value: >50% of trades and >50% of profit from holds >10 s, payout gate
microscalping.quote: Over 50% of your trades are longer than 10 seconds / Over 50% of your profit must come from trades held longer than 10 seconds.

frequency.value: when conditions met; one open request per account
frequency.quote: Payout requests can be submitted directly from your dashboard once payout conditions have been met.

processing.value: 24-48 h after approval; up to 72 h outside business hours
processing.quote: Payments will be issued within 24-48 hours after the withdrawal has been processed.

scaling.quote: Growth and Lightning use their maximum position size from day one; Select funded accounts scale up as the account grows

max_accounts.quote: The 5-account cap applies to active Sim Funded accounts per household.

reset.quote: the Simulated Funded counterpart cannot be reset.
